svg.title: Conversation managers and where the loop runs them
svg.desc: Two steps in every iteration of the agent loop, both before the model call. Compact the state: only a ContextCompactor rewrites state.messages, once the context reaches its threshold, and the on_before_compaction hook runs first and can cancel the compaction or add instructions for the summary. Shape the request: the configured manager's async_apply() trims a copy of the messages for this request and the state is unchanged. Think then calls the model and Execute runs its tool calls; the reply and its tool results join the list and the next iteration starts. With ObservationPack on, the tool output a compaction clears goes to an OutputArchive and the stub left behind names the id obs_recall reads it back by. What each strategy keeps: NullManager keeps everything. SlidingWindowManager keeps the leading system messages and the last window_size messages; the oldest are dropped, and the opening task is re-attached only when no user turn survives. SummarizingManager keeps the system prompt, folds older turns into one summary message and keeps the last keep_recent messages. LLMCompactor works on a token budget: stale tool output becomes a stub, the first head_turns and a token-budgeted tail stay, and the middle is folded into a summary when summarize_fn is set or dropped otherwise. ContextCompactor first clears old tool output to stubs, keeping the newest whole; when that is not enough it keeps the system prompt, the task and the latest user message verbatim with the last tail_turns turns, and folds the older turns into a summary written by its summary model. A compaction that cannot get under the threshold ends the run with context_exhausted. With no conversation_manager the agent uses ContextCompactor when the model's window is known, LLMCompactor instead when compaction is turned off, and SlidingWindowManager when the window is unknown.
svg.text: Every iteration: the termination checks run first,
then the request is kept inside the window and sent.
next iteration · the reply and its tool results join the list
async_apply() shapes each request; state.messages is unchanged
compact() rewrites state.messages; when it cannot get under the threshold the run ends: context_exhausted
Dashed chips are conditional: a summary needs summarize_fn.
SlidingWindowManager re-attaches the task when no user turn survives the window.
No conversation_manager: window known → ContextCompactor, or LLMCompactor when compaction is off; unknown → SlidingWindowManager.
